gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.224: A knife on a grown monster's body carves out its fat. Render it down on a fire, in a furnace or in a cooking pot, and you have grease for a crucible.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.225: Grease and the right essences make a blade oil in a crucible. Four kinds bite four kinds of monster: the dead, beasts, brutes and people. A coated blade hits harder for twenty, forty or sixty swings.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.226: An oil pot keeps an oil. Pour a flask in, dip a blade in it, or fill a sash or bandolier from it. It slowly fills itself back up.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.227: Oil spilled on the ground makes a slick that slows whoever walks in it. A spark, a torch or a burning arrow near it and it all goes up at once.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.228: Acid oil thrown at ore dissolves the rock around it and leaves extra ore. The strongest acid eats soft blocks away too.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.229: A magic snuffer bomb silences magic where it lands. A healing stopper dust stops regeneration, invisibility and turning for a while.
